question: Will Bitcoin exceed $83,800 on CoinGecko at 23:45 UTC on 1 Oct 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the CoinGecko USD price for Bitcoin (BTC) at 2026-10-01T23:45:00.000Z is strictly greater than $83,800.
- "No": Wins if that same price is $83,800 or below.

Clarifications:
- The governing figure is CoinGecko's USD price for id "bitcoin" at that instant — the last published value at or before 2026-10-01T23:45:00.000Z if there is no tick exactly then.
- CoinGecko is the measure. An exchange-specific pair such as Binance BTC/USDT can fall on the opposite side of the threshold.
